statistics.quote: In the trail-making test, the completion time for young subjects was 27.4±7.2 s and that for old subjects was 42.5±6.9 s; the difference was statistically significant (t(22)=5.25; P<0.001).

parsed.notes: The screening test described in the outcome definition corresponds to the paper's trail-making test (numbers 1-25 connected in ascending order, time to completion recorded). The only statistic on these pages for that measure is t(22)=5.25, P<0.001. Other statistics on page 3 concern pointing errors (ANOVAs on Age, Episode, and their interaction), tracking above-baseline error (Procedure effect F(1,43)=144,09, P<0.001), and the reaction-time test is described but no result for it appears on these pages; none of those were transcribed as they measure different outcomes. The sentence for the trail-making test appears truncated at the page end ("When each subject's data were"), so any follow-up analysis continues beyond these pages.
